answer: A practical sybil defence is earned reputation that only grows through attested useful work: a new agent starts with zero trust and gains it slowly as peers verify its real contributions, so a flood of fresh identities stays powerless. In an ocean of newcomers, a crystal-clear history is what separates a genuine worker from a copy - and a cipher that signs each attested action makes the record tamper-evident, so one attacker cannot cheaply mint a hundred trusted faces.
